channel.title: Times of San Diego - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Times of San Diego (timesofsandiego.com)

item.title: Section of University Avenue near school full of litter, adult businesses, marijuana odor
item.description: Liquor bottles, vape packages, hand rolls, and whip-its were among the litter scattered across the street and sidewalks during a recent walk.

item.title: San Diego advances $15M for projects totaling 528 affordable homes
item.description: The city of San Diego Monday recommended allocating $15 million in Bridge to Home funding to four proposed housing projects which would create a total of 528 affordable homes, pending city council approval.

item.title: Point Loma finally gets its own neighborhood gateway sign
item.description: The new Point Loma gateway sign on Rosecrans was assembled in the middle of the night so as to not exacerbate heavy traffic,

item.title: New heights: Endangered Masai giraffe welcomes first calf at San Diego Zoo
item.description: Endangered Masai giraffe Mawe has stepped into motherhood for the first time welcoming her first calf last month, the San Diego Zoo announced Monday.

item.title: Praising ‘even-handedness,’ City Council reelects Joe LaCava as president
item.description: The San Diego City Council Monday quickly and unanimously reelected Joe LaCava as Council President for the next year.

item.title: Cross-border service CBX celebrates ten years of travel
item.description: The Cross Border Xpress, also called Puerta de las Californias (Door to the Californias) has now been in operation for ten years.

item.title: Lawson-Remer, Aguirre move to block Trump’s SoCal offshore drilling plans
item.description: County Board of Supervisors Chair Terra Lawson-Remer and Supervisor Paloma Aguirre joined environmental groups Monday to oppose the Trump administration's plan to reopen offshore drilling leases along the Southern California coast.

item.title: Sen. Blakespear secures $3.59M for Oceanside Museum of Art renovation
item.description: The Oceanside Museum of Art has received a major boost toward its renovation and expansion project, with Sen. Catherine S. Blakespear, D-Encinitas, Monday presenting a $3.59 million check to the city.

item.title: San Diego judge sentences Sinaloa Cartel kingpin’s wife to 14 years in prison
item.description: The wife of a Sinaloa Cartel kingpin was sentenced in San Diego federal court Monday to 14 years in prison for her role in her husband's organization's drug trafficking and money laundering offenses.

item.title: Woman sentenced in human smuggling case off Del Mar that killed four
item.description: One of five people charged by federal prosecutors for their roles in a human smuggling event that led to the deaths of four people -- including two children -- off the coast of northern San Diego County was sentenced Monday to 21 months in prison.
